gain.controls: Channel gain fader and numeric value
gain.notes: The raw range 0..400 is -60..+12 dB. Raw 0 is labelled Muted in trackdsp. Double-click unity is a trackdsp convenience, not a measured vendor default. User-requested double-click defaults now cover every fader, with factory-backed values and explicit unity overrides retained.

mute.notes: Mute and bottom gain colour the knob, not its track.

sensitivity.notes: Connected-device verification is postponed by the user until a later hardware session. The vendor offers 0..50 dB in 1 dB steps. Trackdsp exposes only the captured modes 1..3.
sensitivity.verify: Send 55 00 33 and read input byte 9 back before extending the mode range. See the Protocol sensitivity TODO.

phantom.notes: Control exists; its configuration readback location remains unmeasured.

meters.controls: Input, output and Aux level meters
meters.notes: Meter taps and calibrated scale follow docs/measurements.md; vendor clipping semantics remain unresolved separately.

limit.notes: Connected-device verification is postponed by the user until a later hardware session. Lamp exists; byte 51 interpretation still needs live confirmation.
limit.verify: Run the byte-51 test and observe the vendor Limit lamp. See the Protocol TODO.

clip.notes: Connected-device verification is postponed by the user until a later hardware session. Trackdsp lights at 0 dB; the correct clip trigger for arbitrary programme is unconfirmed.
clip.verify: Compare sine and high-crest-factor programme against the vendor Clip lamp and the measured output ceiling. See Rewrite TODO.

overview.controls: Input/output EQ curve switches and curve overview
overview.notes: Trackdsp uses one overview with independently selectable channels.

gate.notes: Threshold -90..+20 dB, attack 1..999 ms and release 1..3000 ms match the range shots. Raw threshold 0 is treated as inactive.

compressor.controls: Output compressor threshold, ratio, attack and release
compressor.notes: Threshold -90..+20 dB, ratios 1:1.0..Limit, attack 1..999 ms and release 1..3000 ms match. There is no vendor knee control.

aux-comp.controls: Aux compressor four faders and transfer plot
aux-comp.notes: Aux attack ends at 200 ms and release at 999 ms. The Comp page and Aux dialog share these limits.

aux-active.notes: Connected-device verification is postponed by the user until a later hardware session. No equivalent activity lamp is implemented because its trigger is unconfirmed.
aux-active.verify: Observe the Aux Active LED while sweeping through its threshold and capture the meter reply. Do not infer activity from an output bit.

delay.controls: Output delay faders and ms / m / ft
delay.notes: 0..680 ms, 233.580 m, 766.329 ft match. The conversion uses 343.5 m/s and 3.2808 ft/m.

routing.controls: Out1..Out8 source buttons for In1..In8 and Aux

routing-view.notes: Trackdsp provides the graph and matrix; graph dragging remains a separate enhancement.

peq.controls: PEQ band frequency, Q, gain, type and bypass
peq.notes: Inputs/Aux have 5 bands, outputs 7. Frequency 19.7 Hz..20.16 kHz, Q 0.40..128.00 and gain -12..+12 dB match. The initial Q=121 shot was superseded by its retake.

peq-curves.controls: Mag, Phase, band/filter handles and dragging
peq-curves.notes: The plotted filter math is approximate; hardware agreement remains a measurement TODO. User-requested extensions make the wheel step HPF/LPF type and double-click toggle individual point bypass. Linked writes use the existing controls; global EQ Bypass still overrides PEQ bands.

peq-all.notes: Input and output captures show frequency, Q and gain at every band point. User-requested Show all filters also includes HPF/LPF values and effective bypass. The remembered crossover type remains visible while bypassed. PEQ labels share the knobs’ bandIdle() colour rule, including Peak/shelf gain 0 dB. Shared input, output and Aux views use a browser-only display preference.

peq-bypass.notes: The band state has an equivalent; whether global bypass affects HPF/LPF still needs hardware measurement.

peq-reset.notes: Connected-device verification is postponed by the user until a later hardware session. Input/output reset exists. Aux reset frequencies require online confirmation.
peq-reset.verify: Capture Aux EQ Reset online and compare emitted frequencies with resources/factory_config.bin. See Protocol TODO.

filters.controls: HighPass / LowPass frequency, slope and Bypass
filters.notes: Frequency range matches. Slope labels come from captured value lists; bypass maps to raw slope 0.

aux-switches.controls: AutoMix / Effect / Camera Off, On and Set

mix.controls: AutoMix / Camera threshold, attack, release and source buttons
mix.notes: Connected-device verification is postponed by the user until a later hardware session. Threshold -50..0 dB matches. Vendor attack/release reach 5000 ms; trackdsp retains smaller ranges pending readback.
mix.verify: Send raw attack/release 4999, read back and capture the vendor reply before widening. See Protocol TODO.

effect.notes: Echo delay 0..400 ms matches; scalar controls use the surveyed 0..100 ranges.

names.notes: Names are edited immediately; page title editing is another counterpart.

groups.controls: Four input/four output group percentage, membership and Mute

rs232.controls: RS232 command, ID, parameters and generated packet
rs232.notes: The local builder includes 28 documented commands and six additional named commands from recorded vendor packets, plus raw CMD/data bytes. It sends nothing. Group Matrix offers channel checkboxes and the editable mask byte.

rs232-extra.notes: Group Matrix endpoint screenshots establish In1 = 01 and In8 = 80 in data byte three for both Group Input1 and Group Output4. Checkboxes use the standard sequential eight-bit mask alongside an editable raw byte. Vendor In1..In8 captions are retained on both group sides. This evidence describes local code generation, not device acceptance.

Apply to device is a separate confirmed action. User-confirmed offline vendor loading is satisfied by equivalent independent inspection. Connected-device Upload/Download direction remains a separate unresolved outcome.

file-save.notes: On 2026-10-03 the user supplied files/SdWa5_Default_Preset_3_DSPs_eqbypass_testtone_delayft.prs after saving with EQ bypass, test tone and feet selected. It is byte-for-byte identical to the original 1278-byte fixture, SHA-256 3c7a2662d19170063ec090183a01b1b58ef50cab0f31620a27b4c267906badac. The existing importer reads it successfully and leaves tone mode, delay unit and all channel EQ bypass values unknown. The user then reported that reopening offline resets test tone to its default while EQ bypass and delay unit stay unchanged. This establishes vendor UI behavior, not hardware writes. Trackdsp saves settings as JSON, which satisfies equivalent save functionality under the audit plan. Native .prs export remains a separate enhancement in the Rewrite TODO.

counterparts.contains: Reset all EQ bands on this channel?

reset-confirm.notes: The vendor asks before resetting EQ. The shared PEQ controller now asks once before any input, output or Aux band write. Cancellation writes nothing. Existing reset frequencies are preserved.

serial-reference-forms.notes: The manual intends Language selection from the main menu. The captured UI lacks that menu; the official V1.0 resource hides LanguageSel and startup selects English. No supported alternative was found in the inspected code paths or documentation. Language switching is documented but unavailable in the inspected build. Dormant handlers and bundled translations do not establish accessible vendor functionality and are not a confirmed trackdsp gap. Binary patching is outside the audit. The serial-reference forms still need their roles established. See captures/vendor_menu_resources.json. Further analysis found a single neutral main-form resource and a caption selector using the application language field, not a Windows locale query. The user reported that Windows is now Chinese while the editor remains English. This result supports unavailable language switching in that setup; editor restart and binary identity were not independently verified.
serial-reference-forms.verify: Inspect serial-reference form handler references read-only to establish their roles. Reopen language capture tasks only after finding a vendor-documented procedure or reproducing a supported entry in an unmodified editor; compare its hash with the recorded official build. If the editor stayed open during the Windows-language change, restart it once to complete that counter-test. A legacy system-locale test remains separate and optional. Do not reinstall or patch the editor solely to expose hidden resources. If no supported entry exists, record an evidenced exclusion.

pts.notes: The official editor resource contains a PtsSetup menu item with Visible=false and an OnClick binding to PtsSetupClick. Its caption is 次數鎖, referring to a count lock. TFMPTSPASSWORD and TFMPTSSETUP are included in the package. This establishes a hidden default entry, not the expansion of PTS or its hardware behavior. See captures/vendor_menu_resources.json.
pts.verify: Inspect PtsSetupClick and any code changing PtsSetup visibility read-only to establish its role and a supported entry path. Do not invoke the lock or change device state. Capture only if a supported offline path is identified; otherwise retain the unresolved purpose with the static resource evidence.

information.notes: The offline Factory Default action shows an Information message with No device connected !! and OK. Trackdsp has the corresponding disconnected-state error. Visible controls are captured; the role-based TfmInformation association still needs a runtime class check because several dumped forms share an information caption.
information.verify: Identify the current Information popup with a read-only Windows control dump using GetClassNameW. Existing screenshots already cover the message; no repeat screenshot or connected device is needed for this class check.

memo.notes: The official editor resource contains a MemoShow menu item with Visible=false and an OnClick binding to MemoShowClick. TFMMEMO is included in the package. Its runtime visibility, content and role remain unverified. See captures/vendor_menu_resources.json.
memo.verify: Inspect MemoShowClick and any code changing MemoShow visibility read-only to determine whether this is a diagnostic helper or a supported user feature. Capture only if a supported offline entry is identified; do not classify it as a helper solely because its default menu is hidden.

The precise vendor opening gesture was not recorded; the separate sixteen-name header form remains mapped independently.
